name: useflex/media-studio
description: Self-hosted media library for Laravel with workspace storage, optional AI and Filament integrations.

suggest.spatie/laravel-medialibrary: Optional Spatie Media Library v11 integration for existing media, collections and conversions.
suggest.laravel/mcp: Optional Laravel MCP ^1.1 server for authorized AI client access.
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: HTTP client (^7.9 or ^8.0) for the optional Web Push transport.
suggest.minishlink/web-push: Optional Web Push transport (^11.0) for desktop notifications.
suggest.laravel/ai: Optional Laravel AI SDK (^1.4) for the configurable Studio chat assistant.
suggest.laravel/fortify: Optional standalone account module (^1.42): login, verified email, password reset and two-factor authentication.
suggest.waguilar33/filament-guardian: Optional Filament role editor (^1.15) compatible with the required Spatie Permission v8.
suggest.laravel/boost: Optional development-time guidelines and media-studio-development skill discovery; not required by Studio at runtime.
